changeSet.author: Satyam087
changeSet.comment: Seeds default 'retroci.dbs.sampleType' configuration in site_information for RetroCI mode. Allows configuring which sample type (by abbreviation or name) represents DBS instead of hard-coding 'DBS'.

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clinlims.site_information WHERE name = 'retroci.dbs.sampleType'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clinlims.site_information_domain WHERE name = 'siteIdentity'

column.name: description
column.value: Default clinical sample type identifier or local abbreviation for RetroCI DBS accessions
